items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Didn’t Bobbie Gentry do that one? Or did she do a different one? I think she might have done it, too.

ctx.x: Perhaps this would be a good time for another short break, and we have part 3 and see how long it takes for us to get up to the present.
